Strategy: Choose the placement that makes the remaining residuals most equal, minimizing the sum of squared deviations from their mean after placement. Balanced bins may stay usable longer. It may help by spreading usage evenly, but may fail if equalizing sacrifices the tight fits that save bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-sum([(y - sum([x - item if x == r else x for x in bins]) / len(bins)) ** 2 for y in [x - item if x == r else x for x in bins]]) for r in bins]
```
